newsitem.title: USA: Ameristar, Gem amend merger agreement.
newsitem.headline: Ameristar, Gem amend merger agreement.

text.p: Ameristar Casinos Inc and Gem Gaming Inc have amended their May 30 merger agreement so that Ameristar does not issue common stock to Gem shareholders, Ameristar said.
Under the original merger agreement, Gem was to become a subsidiary of Ameristar for 7.5 million shares of Ameristar common stock.
But the amendment will have Gem shareholders get the right to receive the net proceeds of the first 7.5 million shares of Ameristar common stock sold in an underwritten offering.
Ameristar also said Gem Chief Executive Officer Steven Rebeil had decided not to join Ameristar's management after the merger.
Gem is building The Reserve Hotel & Casino in a Las Vegas suburb.
